positive_cases.name: task_action_user_temp
positive_cases.scenario: Task registered with an action in the per-user temporary directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Registration event and action path selections both match.

positive_cases.name: task_action_windows_temp
positive_cases.scenario: Task registered with an action in the machine temporary directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Registration event and action path selections both match.

negative_cases.name: task_action_managed_path
negative_cases.scenario: Task registered with an action in a managed program directory.
negative_cases.rationale: Registration event matches but the action path is not user writable.

negative_cases.name: task_deleted_event
negative_cases.rationale: Path fragment matches but the event identifier is a deletion, not a creation.

negative_cases.name: task_description_mentions_temp
negative_cases.scenario: Task registered whose description text mentions temporary files.
negative_cases.rationale: The description does not contain a matching path fragment, so no selection hits.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
